verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents automated retries of failed subscription and invoice payments (Smart Retries) and customer communications driven by Billing automations. A Stripe PM also confirms customer emails such as card-update notices exist (off by default), so the core of a retry-plus-email dunning flow is present. Missing for 10: branded dunning emails (branding is only documented for invoices and the portal), in-app banners, configurable grace periods, final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), and hands-on corroboration of the full sequence.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
Stripe Billing PM stated all customer emails (like credit card update notices) are off by default
